release_notes:
1. Zero-DOM Wishlist Detection: Intercepts network AJAX (XHR/Fetch) and verified PrestaShop event bus; removes all DOM/CSS click listeners.
2. Universal Wishlist Integration Layer: Authoritative backend ObjectModel resolution for blockwishlist, ps_wishlist, and custom theme wishlists.
3. Native In-Place Upgrade: Seamless 1-click update via upgrade-1.8.1.php.
